items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: Oh I didn't know him, I just heard of him, I read about him.

ctx.x: No. Freddie played trumpet. Freddie played trumpet, yeah.
Was he a blonde headed? Oh I didn't know him, I just heard of him, I read about him. How many brothers was that, I'm trying to think. At least three.
Yeah. Well it must have been Freddie then, I was trying to think of his first name.
